name: Forger's Foundry
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {U}. When you spend this mana to cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 3 or less, you may exile that spell instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard as it resolves.
{3}{U}{U}, {T}: You may cast any number of spells from among cards exiled with this artifact without paying their mana costs. Activate only as a sorcery.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Add {U}. When you spend this mana to cast an instant or sorcery spell with mana value 3 or less, you may exile that spell instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard as it resolves.

needs.what: an op usable inside a mana_spent_trigger (or spell_cast trigger) that marks the bound `subject` spell on the stack so that, as it resolves, it is exiled instead of going to its owner's graveyard, with the exiled card linked to the source permanent (obj.exiled_by = this artifact) so a later selector `{"zone": "exile", "exiled_with": "self"}` finds it; wrapped in `may` for the optional choice
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_rebound and grant_plot are the right shape (riders written on the stack object, read by _place_after_resolution) but each adds its own mechanic (free cast next upkeep / plotted) and neither links the card to the source; StackItem.exiles_instead is set only by the caster (cast_for_free paths), and an `exile` op in the trigger would remove the spell from the stack before it resolves. Without the link, the second ability's 'cards exiled with this artifact' has nothing to find
